significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a limited form-(iii) ordering—on matched problems, higher framed social status produces more thinking tokens—and a form-(ii) mechanism in which a "status-sensitive effort-budget representation read at the prompt boundary" causally controls that allocation. This would establish both a specific behavioral phenomenon and its mechanism, fixing expectations across status ladders and explaining one source of inefficient or unequal compute allocation, but it remains a side cause of reasoning inefficiency rather than resolving the general token-allocation problem addressed by budget-forcing work such as s1 (Muennighoff et al., 2025) and thinking-budget controls in Qwen3 (2025). Verified false and verified true are distinguishable: a null would rule out status as a material compute-allocation driver in the stated model class, although it would not discriminate among broader explanations of overthinking or adaptive computation. In the topic-substitution check, generic "efficient reasoning from a mechanism perspective" would not retain this score; the matched-status ordering and causal boundary signal are the claim-specific increment, but their confinement to one behavioral disparity keeps the conclusion near the topic median.

reach.justification: The claim names two usable handles: "effort parity" as an audit metric and a "training-free debiasing steer" that edits the proposed effort-budget signal. Effort parity is primarily post hoc because it measures token disparities after reasoning traces are generated, whereas the steer is ex ante and could equalize allocation before an answer is produced, giving auditors or deployers an action window. The status-to-token ordering could remain a prediction after recalibration on another reasoning model, but the activation direction itself is likely model-dependent; the hypothesis nevertheless asserts applicability across reasoning LLMs and status ladders, with potential uptake by teams auditing or shipping education, healthcare, and enterprise assistants. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: efficient reasoning alone supplies neither an equity audit nor a status-conditioned inference-time intervention, and the named ex-ante handle therefore supports reach above the topic median.
